verdict.rationale: Unity ships an official AI Assistant that accepts natural-language messages (consuming Unity Credits per message) and an official MCP server (beta) integrated into the Editor, per unity-docs-14 and unity-probe-rt-1, showing genuine natural-language operation of the tool. However this is explicitly beta, credit-metered, has no public/open repo (closed distribution), and there's no independent hands-on evidence of its reliability compared to the much larger community MCP project. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the Assistant's command execution, GA (non-beta) status, and documentation of the scope of natural-language commands it can actually perform.
